decisions.decision: The supplied seed reproducibly selects the start player.
Any affected player with staged cards may plant next; all staged cards must be planted before phase four, and each owner chooses their own card order.
Off-turn harvesting is exposed at stable player decision boundaries, not inside an atomic draw, shuffle, transfer, or planting transition.
Observations expose own full ordered hand and each opponent’s hand size and source-visible front card, but not deeper opponent identities.
